register.labelZh: PUZZLE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: puzzle over/about 描述仔細思考的過程;puzzle something out 則表示某人弄清楚事情或找出答案。；這些表達適合用來談論提示、密碼、地圖、說明、謎題和令人困惑的事件。；你可以使用 puzzle out,表示某人仔細思考後,弄懂機器、應用程式、規則、規律或方法。；PUZZLE 片語動詞能讓你自然地描述認真而仔細的思考。
register.summaryEn: Puzzle over/about describes the thinking process, while puzzle something out shows that someone understands something or finds an answer. These expressions are useful when discussing clues, codes, maps, instructions, puzzles and confusing events. You can use puzzle out to describe understanding a machine, an app, a rule, a pattern or a method after careful thought. The PUZZLE expressions give you a natural way to describe serious and careful thought.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 當某人花時間仔細思考某事時,使用 puzzle over/about something。當某人透過仔細思考弄清楚某事或找出答案時,使用 puzzle something out。；保留原句中的人物、事物、時間、結果和意思。；在 puzzle ... out 中使用 it 或 them 時,把它放在 PUZZLE 和 OUT 中間。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Use puzzle over/about something when someone spends time thinking hard about something. Use puzzle something out when someone understands it or finds the answer through careful thought. Keep the same people, things, time, result and meaning. When using it or them with puzzle... out, place the word between PUZZLE and OUT: puzzle it out puzzle them out
